# SCAM Watch

> Public evidence database for online scams, marketplace fraud, copied listings, payment scams, phishing, impersonation, and consumer fraud warnings.

Primary resources:
- /README.md — project overview and classification framework
- /METHODOLOGY.md — evidence and classification standards
- /CORRECTIONS.md — correction and dispute process
- /DISCLAIMER.md — limitations and identity cautions
- /cases/ — individual incident reports
- /categories/ — fraud category guides
- /data/incidents.json — machine-readable incident records

Important interpretation rule: a seller/account identity shown in a case is an identity presented by that account unless the case expressly states that real-world identity was independently verified.

`llms.txt` is provided as a non-standard machine-readable navigation aid. It does not replace robots.txt, sitemaps, standard HTML navigation, or search-engine webmaster tools.
